assessments.reasoning: The array definition identifies the shape as a list of nonnegative integer lengths. The number of elements in its ravel is the array bound, defined as the product of all those lengths.

challenge.method: Read the enclosing type definition and consider zero lengths, nested elements and the distinction between an abstract list and representation.
challenge.results: The definition uses nonnegative lengths and an abstract element count. A zero length produces a zero product, and the passage allows nested values without imposing storage layout.

limitations: Applies to the exact pre-versioning core draft. No representation or implementation behavior was verified.
